horizon_relationship.linkage_method: Four dependent causal nodes—core Wix health, Base44 retained-production adoption, Base44 fully loaded economics, and outside-agent attachment/disintermediation—replace the former bundled regime. The same node states, shared frontier/operating factors, starting diluted-share/net-claims state, and sources-and-uses bridge carry through both formal horizons; checkpoint shocks are correlated. Claims reduction is tied to retained owner FCFE and earnout remeasurement to the simulated Base44 ARR path. The target-date denominator is held flat because current awards are already included and future award vintages are charged explicitly in owner FCFF. Four- and ten-month operating checkpoints are not additional fair-value horizons. There is no market-convergence forecast.
horizon_relationship.sensitivity_note: The formal distribution is target-date SOTP fair value; owner-FCFF DCF and cash multiples are non-voting cross-checks. Wix's three-year revenue-guidance error history informs a separately scoreable near-term revenue interval, while causal-node probabilities remain structured judgments. Three alternative same-evidence probability sets produce twelve-month medians of $126.89-$128.40; deliberately skeptical/favorable weights produce $109.66/$146.12 and 32.4%/11.8% frequencies below reference. With unchanged marginals, independent nodes produce P10 $73.75 and 5.4% frequency of fair value at least 30% below reference; stronger plausible dependence produces $61.89 and 9.8%, versus current $67.74 and 7.5%. Common-random-number stresses show that a +/-0.5x core multiple has the largest listed median effect (-$20.49/+$20.65), followed by a +/-2x Base44 multiple (-$10.12/+$10.59) and +/-2m diluted shares (+$5.70/-$5.23). Ten 50,000-draw seeds produce medians of $127.49-$128.33, showing that sampling noise is much smaller than assumption risk. The if-converted convention omits capped-call value through $267.89. Legacy contract fields named probability_loss_* mean probability that target-date fair value is 30%/50% below today's reference, not realized security loss.
